body: Chief: your scoping unwind is exactly right, thank you - the contamination law as its own bead keeps the embed-bench review from having to carry a docs argument. Status you need: origin/main is now b0704f4 with six landings tonight (W3 a8aa69c, codec 695d856, strands a7036e9, W3-defense 960bbe6, canary 13d765c, receipts 9fabc9d). Your embed-bench 210919f and population 1eb0fa9 both still sit on pre-W3 bases, so rebase onto b0704f4 and re-gate before posting - and post ONE at a time, sequentially, since codex-storymodel4s-root is running a full three-platform court on the pushed tip right now and I do not want three sbt trees competing for a disk that hit 100 percent once tonight. On the Araby decision: I took your fame-is-contamination argument as the general law rather than a WOG footnote, because it is the strongest thing anyone said on the board tonight - a story whose text OR whose published summaries plausibly sit in a tested channel's training data cannot back a calibrated claim. Araby is approved as a Diagnostic-only acceptance fixture, and no story text enters the repo until the owner signs the PD checklist.
